items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Wille Vodery, he wrote for 23 years for the Ziegfeld Follies. He'd give you a score and tell you -- he'd trust you to add two trumpets to it or two clarinets to it.

ctx.x: You told me how certain other musicians would do it,
would give you a score and say -- Wille Vodery, he wrote for 23 years for the Ziegfeld Follies. He'd give you a score and tell you -- he'd trust you to add two trumpets to it or two clarinets to it.

And you've told me about -- we've discussed -- and I'm aware of this and I know all this, about all of these people that you've written for, the bands that you had, you were the musical director at the Apollo Theater for years. How does it happen that in books like -- Leonard Feather's Book of Jazz, Stanley Dance 's book. Nobody mentions your name. How does that --
